summary: fortinet.fortios changes in 10.0.0: notes on backup in the monitor and monitor_fact modules, support for FortiOS 7.4.2/7.4.3 and a mac_address data type, true/false booleans in docs, log_fact doc updates, version ranges instead of exact versions, and required Ansible raised to 2.14 and then 2.15.
questions: Which FortiOS versions does the fortios collection in Ansible 10 support?
What minimum ansible-core does fortinet.fortios require now?
Does fortios support MAC address data types?

answer_card.title: fortinet.fortios changes in 10.0.0
answer_card.answer_md:
- Supports FortiOS 7.4.2 and 7.4.3, plus a `mac_address` data type.
- Requires ansible-core 2.15 (raised from 2.14).
- Version support is documented as ranges.
- Backup notes were added to the `monitor` and `monitor_fact` module docs.
